title: Correct Tenant-Notice Method
description: Conservative compliance checklist capable of tenant-lawyer review; not attorney approval.

rows.label: Verify coverage
rows.value: Check exact address in SF Planning PIM; confirm exemptions
rows.notes: Exact address not supplied in this case.

rows.label: Verify license
rows.value: Current Rent Increase License on effective date

rows.label: Verify 12 months / anniversary
rows.value: At least 12 months since last increase
rows.notes: Use rate in effect on increase date.

rows.label: Verify banked amounts
rows.value: SF guidance distinguishes skipped increases (24 full months without an increase) from unused portions of partial increases (at least 12 months later or a future anniversary). Add eligible percentages; do not compound or prorate.
rows.notes: Do not infer banking from a missing history.

rows.label: Written notice timing
rows.value: Generally 30 days, or 90 days if the increase alone or combined with other increases in the preceding 12 months is more than 10%; add applicable mail time.
rows.notes: Both mailing and address within California add five calendar days; CCP 1013 specifies longer extensions in other circumstances.

rows.label: Notice contents
rows.value: Dollar amount, percentage, effective date; banked portion if any

rows.label: Delivery
rows.value: Personal delivery or mail under Civil Code 827 / CCP 1013

rows.label: Neutral policy
rows.value: Identical written neutral policy, dates, calculations and recordkeeping for each eligible unit
rows.notes: Document neutral eligibility reasons if only one unit is raised.

rows.label: Legal review
rows.value: Capable of tenant-lawyer review; no approval claimed
rows.notes: Free counseling is not legal advice; TRC covers eviction proceedings.

rows.label: Confirm license for the effective date
rows.value: Report into the Housing Inventory and confirm a current license for each unit and each increase effective date.
rows.notes: Confirming before service is prudent; an increase effective while unlicensed can be null and void under Rule 13.14.

rows.label: Keep the license record
rows.value: File the license record and a dated portal lookup with the notice and proof of service
rows.notes: Evidence if the increase is challenged.

rows.label: 90-day notice if the total exceeds 10%
rows.value: 90 days when the increase alone or combined with another increase in the same year is more than 10%
rows.notes: The 90-day notice rule is not permission to impose an increase: pending File 261020 could affect banked increases (F46).

rows.label: Check the retaliation clock
rows.value: Before serving notice, review tenantability complaints and other qualifying events within the prior 180 days and consult counsel about retaliation risks
rows.notes: Section 1942.5(a) addresses retaliatory increases with conditions; subsection (g) addresses lawful cause. Other retaliation rules may also apply.

rows.label: Keep the fee separate
rows.value: Pay or confirm the Rent Board Fee ($59.00 per dwelling unit for 2026-2027, due March 1) and, if recovering 50%, show it as a separate fee recovery rather than folding it into the rent increase
rows.notes: The fee is not part of base rent.

rows.label: Match each notice to a license on its effective date
rows.value: Check the portal license status for the specific effective date of each notice, for each unit, including any prior year
rows.notes: A license now does not cure a notice effective before it existed.

rows.label: Do not backdate or assume a notice is invalid based only on its service date
rows.value: If a served notice has not yet taken effect, check whether a current license can be confirmed by its effective date. If an increase took effect while unlicensed, get advice before re-serving; do not backdate.
rows.notes: Rule 13.14 specifies the effective date, not the date of service; other notice requirements still apply.

rows.label: Work through the Notice Worksheet
rows.value: The Notice Worksheet page lists the pre-service gates, required notice contents, service rules and a per-tenant service log, each row linked to its official source
rows.notes: Published from the B87 official-source kit (research/b87_notice_kit); case cells stay blank until verified.
